items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: I put Joe Olive on my place... that day I was playing with the Silver Leaf band... they all knew where I was at.

ctx.x: Yeah, it's all depends on who you was playing with, for, too. That's another band. You see, that's like anything else. You've got to learn your people. See? Some of the people who had to play some rough stuff there, I mean rough, very rough. And some people, if you didn't play nice music, you didn't play nothing. Because let me show you what happened. I came here for a vacation. And I put Joe Olive on my place. You all heard about King Olive. And he was playing, that day I was playing with the Silver Leaf band.…
